title: Audit product-level final closure
rawUserRequest: 自检还有功能上是否闭环，旧的代码和文档是否清理完。要以产品级别做为验收标准；发现问题要修正并再自检，直到完整闭环。
outOfScope: Provider configuration, branch-protection settings, publication, and external production operations.
Rewriting historical archived Work Item evidence.

sources.reason: Authoritative completed Work Item contracts, outcomes, and closure evidence.
Current product documentation and legacy terminology audit.
Repository-recorded remediation plan and core Work Item traceability.
Appended Work Item Intelligence Interface acceptance requirements; the direct user instruction is recorded in its immutable Contract.

declaredIntent.summary: Prove the shipped AI Cockpit product is functionally closed, documentation-aligned, and free of obsolete active paths; correct any evidence-backed gap.

riskAssessment.reason: Final acceptance must not overclaim closure without current functional, lifecycle, and documentation evidence.

reasons: Product-level final acceptance carries false-completion and legacy-path risk.

override.approvalEvidence: User authorized all necessary governed Work Item writes, cleanup, PR merge, archive, and closure in this thread.
override.reason: Strict product acceptance with no release operation.
notRunChecks: Release-specific preflight and distribution checks are inapplicable: this Work Item does not modify release-owned resources or publish a release.

executionDecision.reason: User requires product-level closure audit and authorized governed remediation if an evidence-backed gap is found.

preReviewWarnings: Do not treat archived intent or a green narrow check as proof; inspect current behavior and coverage.
If any functional, documentation, or legacy-path gap is found, update scope and repair it in this Work Item before reporting closure.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record audit baseline and final evidence.

acceptance: The archive inventory contains the 21 core planned Work Item identities (WI-01 through WI-22 excluding WI-08) and work-item-intelligence-interface; each record has a closed merged-PR lifecycle receipt or a named, merged, closed replacement record.

Current repository functionality passes the strict quality suite, and current Work Item Intelligence CLI queries cover one Work Item, all active Work Items, action eligibility, and read-only behavior.

Current authoritative documentation passes metadata checks and a five-strategy review; active code/docs contain no legacy fourth release governance profile or global-status-only current interface, while immutable archives remain unchanged.
After clean closure-receipt verification for PR #584 and PR #585, the two detached task checkout directories are removed; the original user directory remains.

At final re-audit, .ai/work-items/active contains only infrastructure placeholders, git worktree list has no stale historical task worktree, every codex cleanup/audit branch has been closed, and the Summary records no unresolved product-level residual risk.
guidelines: Use archived artifacts as immutable history, not as current product configuration.
Distinguish historical compatibility evidence from active legacy code or documentation.
Do not claim closure until current functional and lifecycle evidence is verified.
Do not alter Provider configuration or branch-protection settings.

intent.problem: The user requires a final product-level—not merely process-level—acceptance after many governed Work Items, including functional closure and removal of obsolete code and documentation.
constraints: Audit current main, not only historical reports.
Trace original and appended requirements to current evidence.
Correct any confirmed gap before final closure.
intent.rationale: A current-state audit plus a repair loop provides stronger proof than trusting prior Work Item outcomes.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Core and appended requirements are all traceable to a current implementation, test, or immutable archived delivery with closure evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Cross-check planned IDs, current archive, PR state, and closure receipts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Current product rejects obsolete governance-profile behavior while preserving only documented historical evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: no active legacy release profile or stale global-status-only path
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Search active code/docs and run targeted functional checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Product documentation remains accurate and usable for its audiences.
scenarioCoverage.expected: no consensus or critical factual finding
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Review current authoritative documentation and run metadata checks.

allowPatterns: Remove the clean, receipt-verified registered worktree historical-worktree-cleanup after its closed lifecycle is confirmed.
Remove the clean, receipt-verified registered worktree protected-worktree-status-reconciliation after its closed lifecycle is confirmed.
destructiveChangePolicy.approvalEvidence: User gave standing authorization for governed writes, cleanup, PR merge, archive, and closure in this thread; this policy is limited to the two named closed task worktrees.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Standing conversation authorization covers required governed Work Item writes and lifecycle closure.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item audit record and any confirmed corrective change; retain historical evidence.
